annotations.title: Set my kind of business for the score

description: Set the kind of business the website score is weighed for, with an option id from get_visibility_site_type, or null to go back to the listing's. The next check is scored this way; run_visibility_check shows the new score. Ask the owner first. Owner, admin or operator. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: set_visibility_site_type
